# Scaffold Upgrade

Verifies a persisted 0.4.1 scaffold can update in place.

## Install

```bash
bb plugin install git:https://github.com/brsbl/bb-plugins.git@plugin/scaffold-upgrade --yes
```

## Use

Use Scaffold Upgrade when its focused capability is useful in bb.

## Develop

From the monorepo root:

```bash
npm ci
npm run check --workspace=bb-plugin-scaffold-upgrade
bb plugin install "path:$PWD/plugins/scaffold-upgrade" --yes
```
